verdict.rationale: Feitian publishes a public documentation site (fido.ftsafe.com), so offering llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack shows only conventional human-oriented setup guides and product pages, with no llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation. The only probe checked OpenAPI paths, which all returned 404, and it did not check for llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
